Rajdhani Besan is finely ground chickpea flour, ideal for a variety of dishes. Its rich, nutty flavour and smooth texture enhance traditional recipes, from pakoras to sweets. Perfect for adding depth to your cooking, this besan is pure and versatile, making it a kitchen essential for authentic Indian cuisine. Elevate your dishes with Rajdhani Besan's quality and taste.

Besan is also known as gram flour or chickpea flour. It is made by grinding pure chana dal and made from the best quality chana dal, our Besan from Rajdhani makes for a versatile kitchen flour. No gluten and made using pure desi chana, it has high natural and digestible protein. Arriving with an earthy aroma and binding nature, this makes besan a key ingredient in the batter used for preparing onion pakodas, traditional potato and vegetable bhajiyas and some sweet dishes. Suitable for regular use, its batter can be used in making spicy and crispy fritters as well. Make some delicious recipes with Rajdhani Mota Besan and call it a deal!

Rajdhani Makki Atta is a staple in many households. Enjoy the goodness of maize in every bite, packed with essential nutrients to support a balanced diet.

Rajdhani Whole Wheat - Atta is made from the choicest grains, which are heavy on the palm, golden amber in colour and hard in bite.
